title: what-a-sub-agent-does: data, run records, checkers and harness for a study of hierarchical visibility in multi-agent delegation
description: The complete experimental material behind the study of how much of the supervising hierarchy a delegated worker agent should see, and what it does when it sees it (preprint: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22433898). It contains the analysis plan and its archive hash, the 200 Suite A stimulus items and 30 pilot items, the deterministic checkers with their source hashes (frozen 9179f04a49c2cba4, revised dc79531ca3f268a8) and the Suite B arbiter (5244f7de5c54a4f2), every recorded model call as JSONL for three models (DeepSeek V4 Flash, Meta Muse Spark 1.3 and OpenAI GPT-6.1 Sol) in Suite A and in the Suite B multi-agent loop, the audit samples and returns, the analysis scripts that generate every number, table and figure, the Suite B harness, and the documentation survey of 62 orchestration frameworks. Code is under the MIT License and data and documentation under CC BY 4.0; third-party stimulus material stays under its own terms, and model outputs remain subject to the generating providers' terms (see LICENSE).
